column1: DDCC:VS - Technical Specifications and Implementation Guidance, 27 August 2021

UC001 UC002 UC003 Requirement ID Functional requirement Paper First Offline Digital Online Digital It SHALL be possible to enter or attach the HCID as a 1D DDCC.FXNREQ.008 barcode to any paper vaccination card issued to the Subject of Care (or the HCID card holder). It SHOULD be possible to prepare pre-printed cards with a DDCC.FXNREQ.009 previously generated HCID that is encoded in (at minimum) a 1D barcode. It SHALL be possible to record the core data set content on a DDCC.FXNREQ.010 paper vaccination card issued to the Subject of Care (or the DDCC:VS card holder). It SHALL be possible to manually sign the paper card and include the official stamp of the administering centre as a DDCC.FXNREQ.011 non-digital means of certifying that the content has been recorded by an approved authority. The data concerning the vaccination (at minimum, the HCID and the core data set content) SHOULD be entered into an DDCC.FXNREQ.012 electronic format as soon as reasonably possible after the vaccine is administered. This will most likely be into a Digital Health Solution, if one exists, at the point of care. It SHALL be possible to retrieve information about the DDCC.FXNREQ.013 vaccination(s) administered to the Subject of Care from the content in the DDCC:VS. All data concerning the vaccination SHALL be handled in DDCC.FXNREQ.014 a secure manner to respect confidentiality between the health worker and Subject of Care. Digital technology SHALL NOT be needed for any aspect of DDCC.FXNREQ.015 paper card issue/update – the process SHALL function in an entirely offline and non-electronic manner. Paper cards and the validation markings they bear SHALL be DDCC.FXNREQ.016 designed to combat fraud and misuse. Where an offline (disconnected) Digital Health Solution DDCC.FXNREQ.017 exists, the Data Entry Personnel SHALL securely log in to record all pertinent information about the vaccination. Any offline Digital Health Solution for vaccination DDCC.FXNREQ.018 registration SHALL include required content defined in the DDCC:VS core data set. Any offline Digital Health Solution for vaccination registration SHOULD be designed for quality data capture, DDCC.FXNREQ.019 including enforcement of data validation rules at the point of data entry. If patients’ records are held in an offline Digital Health Solution available at the time of vaccination, then it DDCC.FXNREQ.020 SHOULD be possible for an authorized user to view the record for the Subject of Care, including pertinent medical history, per PHA policies. If an offline Digital Health Solution for vaccination registration is available, then it SHOULD be possible DDCC.FXNREQ.021 to search, list, filter, reorder and export the history of vaccinations administered. If an offline Digital Health Solution for vaccination registration is available, then it MAY be possible to schedule DDCC.FXNREQ.022 a regular, recurring export/dispatch of data, based on availability of a connection, to send them to another public health record system. If an offline Digital Health Solution for vaccination registration DDCC.FXNREQ.023 is available, then it SHALL validate that HCIDs entered are confirmed to be unique, based on its own data set.
